name: EDLR 5465
title: Organizational Change and Sustainability
description: Focuses on essential school leadership aspects of improving schools as educational organizations. Students will examine facets of the school organization that have particular consequence for improving student learning in schools, being particularly mindful of the role the principal plays in influencing change and improvement in schools. Formerly offered as EDLR 5409.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
